description: Recover a lost seat token. Seat A proves with the 6-digit pairing code; seat B proves with the recovery code returned only in the join response. Mints a fresh token; the old one stops working. Anyone with pairCode and the UIN can recover seat A without its token and act as the creator. Keep pairCode private; do not share it for verification.

code.description: Private recovery secret: seat A pairCode or seat B recoveryCode. Never request or share for verification

seat.description: Seat to recover: A or B

name: acq_rejoin
